utkata_konasana.shoulder: Arm muscles parallel to the floor
utkata_konasana.hip: Thighs flat like a tabletop; stand proud

triangle.elbow: Arms as straight and stretched as possible
triangle.shoulder: Both arms vertical to the ground like the letter T
triangle.hip: Body parallel to the ground with one of your legs up too

warrior.elbow: Arms as straight and stretched as possible
warrior.shoulder: Both hands parallel to the floor like the letter T
warrior.knee: Crouch one leg, keep the other straight; ready to fight
warrior.hip: Keep your back straight and strong

tree.shoulder: Shoulders bended and soft like a calm breeze
tree.knee: Ground your standing leg like a sturdy tree trunk
tree.hip: Keep hips steady like the base of a rooted oak

ardha_chandrasana.elbow: Reach the sun with one hand, the other straight to the floor
ardha_chandrasana.shoulder: Both arms vertical to the floor like the letter T
ardha_chandrasana.knee: Lift one leg like it's weightless, floating behind you
ardha_chandrasana.hip: Open your hips, stand strong, body inclined to the side

natarajasana.elbow: Both arms straight, one catches leg, the other reaches the horizon
natarajasana.shoulder: Keep shoulders open like taking a proud bow
natarajasana.knee: Kick the lifted leg back like drawing a graceful arc
natarajasana.hip: Square hips forward like you're gliding on a tightrope

downward_dog.elbow: Arms push the ground away like you're making space
downward_dog.shoulder: Let shoulders melt open like water flowing down
downward_dog.knee: Straighten legs gently like stretching sleepy cats
downward_dog.hip: Lift hips high like forming a perfect mountain peak

cobra.elbow: Arms straight, push the ground; lift up gently
cobra.shoulder: Roll shoulders back like you're showing off a necklace
cobra.knee: Legs long and quiet like a resting snake
cobra.hip: Lift chest forward like a cobra rising proudly

gymnastic_bridge.elbow: Push through arms like you're lifting the sky
gymnastic_bridge.shoulder: Open chest like a shining arc of a rainbow
gymnastic_bridge.knee: Knees stay in line like the tracks of a roller coaster
gymnastic_bridge.hip: Lift hips high like you're creating a glowing bridge

seated_forward_bend.elbow: Let arms drape like soft ribbons, reach far from your tiptoes
seated_forward_bend.hip: Crouch back and head down to reach legs

lotus.elbow: Rest hands like calm petals on a pond
lotus.shoulder: Soften shoulders like you're settling into meditation
lotus.hip: Sit tall like a serene statue carved from stillness

hero.elbow: Place hands gently like you're calming the air
hero.shoulder: Soften shoulders like you're settling into meditation
hero.knee: Knees close like a knight kneeling
hero.hip: Sink hips between heels like sitting on a cloud

plank.elbow: Lock in elbows like sturdy beams
plank.shoulder: Push shoulders away like you're rounding a strong shield
plank.knee: Keep legs straight like a steel bridge
plank.hip: Hold hips steady and your back low

boat.elbow: Reach arms forward like offering someone a gift
boat.shoulder: Shoulders relaxed but awake like you're balancing
boat.hip: Balance on hips like you're gently rocking on water

bow.elbow: Arms strong pull feet back like drawing a powerful bowstring
bow.shoulder: Belly on floor, head rises up a bit
bow.knee: Kick legs up and flexed like you're trying to fly
bow.hip: Lift hips like a rising arc ready to launch
